text:
Hi team,

Please keep routine desk handling consistent and calm across the next set of companion travel moves. Our ground team must continue to move carriers carefully between services, with close attention to labeling, spacing, and secure handoff at each point. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is expected to give crews practical instructions that are brief, clear, and easy to follow. That standard matters because each journey is a shared responsibility, and small lapses in handling can create avoidable stress for both travelers and animals.

When reviewing bookings, focus on the usual safety checks first. Confirm that carrier condition, ventilation, and closure are suitable before release, and make sure any special care notes are carried through without drift from one handoff to the next. If a detail looks uncertain, pause the process and resolve it before the animal is moved onward. We are aiming for dependable companion travel, and that depends on steady judgment rather than speed. A measured response protects the animal, supports the crew, and reduces the chance of service disruption.

Please also keep your written updates concise and factual. Use plain wording, note what was observed, and avoid assumptions that could mislead the next team. If a traveler raises concern, treat it seriously and route the matter through the proper channel without delay. The same approach applies whether the case is routine or slightly unusual. Our expectation at Aurelia Skyways is simple: careful work, clear communication, and consistent follow-through. Thank you for maintaining that standard and for keeping the operation safe and dependable.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
